verdicts.title: Algorithms in Real Algebraic Geometry: A Survey
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We survey both old and new developments in the theory of algorithms in real algebraic geometry -- starting from effective quantifier elimination in the first order theory of reals due to Tarski and Seidenberg, to more recent algorithms for computing topological invariants of semi-algebraic sets. We emphasize throughout the complexity aspects of these algorithms and also discuss the computational hardness of the underlying problems. verdicts.title: Linear Geometry and Algebra
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Linear Geometry studies geometric properties which can be expressed via the notion of a line. All information about lines is encoded in a ternary relation called a line relation. A set endowed with a line relation is called a liner. So, Linear Geometry studies liners. verdicts.title: Test ideals via algebras of $p^{-e}$-linear maps
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Continuing ideas of a recent preprint of Schwede arXiv:0906.4313 we study test ideals by viewing them as minimal objects in a certain class of $F$-pure modules over algebras of p^{-e}-linear operators. This shift in the viewpoint leads to a simplified and generalized treatment, also allowing us to define test ideals in non-reduced settings.
